$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. ImportPreview is named but never specified in the source pack (WP-1 task brief §6) — designed here as step 4 ('Preview') of the six-step manual import grammar (INT-011, docs/ratified/MANUAL_INTEGRATION_GRAMMAR.md): new/changed/duplicate/conflicting/rejected records, computed AFTER Validate (step 3) and BEFORE any mutation, so the user can make an informed Confirm decision (step 5, INT-007 'no silent partial import'). schemaVersion pinned to major 1, FB-RAT-COM-003.
title: ImportPreview
description: The read-only preview Core computes for one source snapshot before any Incident/CustomerIssue/AuditFinding is created or mutated. Carries no side effects itself — it is what the user reviews at the Preview step, and what an eventual ImportReceipt (schemas/integrations/import-receipt.v1.schema.json) confirms a subset (or all) of, via `previewId`.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this preview shape. A reader MUST reject any schemaVersion whose major is not '1' (FB-RAT-COM-003).

previewId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this specific preview computation (FB-RAT-COM-002) — an ImportReceipt backlinks to this id, not to a re-derived preview.

sourceLocation.description: Where this snapshot was read from (a file path, or repo+branch+commit for the Assay lane) — provenance for the eventual receipt's backlink (FB-RAT-COM-008).

generatedAt.description: UTC instant this preview was computed (FB-RAT-COM-004).

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

ImportSourceType.description: Which lane produced the snapshot this preview/receipt concerns — CSApp's issues-manifest.v1 file, or Assay's assay-index.v1 repo output.

IntegrityRef.description: Duplicated from schemas/common/artifact-ref.schema.json's $defs/IntegrityRef per this repo's cross-file convention (docs/ratified/COMMON_CONVENTIONS.md §5) rather than $ref'd across files. Digest of the EXACT bytes read at snapshot time (FB-RAT-COM-005) — recomputed and compared by Core before trusting the source; a mismatch is IMPORT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.

ImportErrorCode.description: The closed IMPORT_* / PROOF_MISSING vocabulary plus the open IMPORT_INVALID_<FIELD> record-level family (registry-hygiene fix — see docs/ratified/MANUAL_INTEGRATION_GRAMMAR.md's error taxonomy and docs/ratified/IMPORT_RECEIPT_V1.md).

existingIncidentId.description: The Incident this source record previously produced (INT-016 — imports create/update Incidents, never Tasks).

priorReceiptId.description: The ImportReceipt.receiptId that already imported this exact record at this exact digest (IMPORT_DUPLICATE_SNAPSHOT — view-only, INT-006).

conflictingFields.description: Fields where the source's value is incompatible with the existing record's identity data (IMPORT_RECORD_CONFLICT) — requires an explicit user choice; both values are retained in the eventual receipt, never silently overwritten (INT-024).

sourceLocation.description: Where within the source this record was found (e.g. an issue id, a SARIF result pointer, a JSON Pointer path) — NOT a filesystem path in the general case, but a reader resolving one into a filesystem/repo path MUST apply the same '..'-segment rejection as any other LOCAL_FS-style locator (see fixtures/integrations/adversarial/import-receipt-path-traversal-sourcelocation.adversarial.json).
